clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, a memorandum calls novice mages to Anvilmar. Mountaineer Sten Stoutarm passes it to new arrivals, who are invited to meet its author, Marryk Nurribit, and begin their spellcraft studies.
Mountaineer Sten Stoutarm has a memorandum for the new mages he assists in Coldridge Valley. He hands it to you and advises you to read it, then go inside Anvilmar to meet the gnome who wrote it.

Inside Anvilmar, gnome mage trainer Marryk Nurribit gives newcomers plain advice before teaching them. Stay out of serious trouble, save coin for training and tavern drinks, and keep clear of fallen Gnomeregan and its radioactive danger. Marryk is ready to teach you the arcane arts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the mage trainer Marryk. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yeah, what's that, traveler? Speak up, if you don't mind. I don't hear so good after a few ales.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, yeah! Arcane Arts... Of course.

Here's what you need to know, friend: Don't get into too much trouble. Save some coin to buy me an ale... Or any spells ya might want. And stay the heck away from Gnomeregan. Other than that, have a good day! I'll be here if you need me or want to train... Or whatever.
